Load Packages

library(tidyverse)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(cowplot)
library(patchwork)

A Single Point

single_point <- tibble(x = 0, y = 0)

single_point |> 
  ggplot(aes(
    x = x,
    y = y
    ))+
  geom_point() +
  theme_void()

Random Lines

number_of_lines <- 300

random_lines <- tibble(
  # Get 50 numbers between 1 and 50 without replacement
  x = sample(1:number_of_lines, number_of_lines),
  y = 1:number_of_lines
  )

random_lines |> 
  ggplot(aes(
    x = x,
    y = y,
    xend = median(x),
    yend = median(y)
  )) +
  geom_segment() +
  theme_void()

Square?

square <- tibble(
  x = c(0, number_of_lines, number_of_lines, 0),
  y = c(0, 0, number_of_lines, number_of_lines)
  )

square |> 
  ggplot(aes(
    x = x,
    y = y
    )) +
  geom_polygon(
    fill = NA,
    colour = "black"
  ) +
  coord_equal() +
  theme_void()

Combine square + random lines

square |> 
  ggplot(aes(
    x = x,
    y = y
    )) +
  geom_polygon(
    fill = NA,
    colour = "black"
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    data = random_lines,
    aes(
      x = x,
      y = y,
      xend = number_of_lines/2,
      yend = number_of_lines/2
    )
  ) +
  coord_equal() +
  theme_void()

Without the xend argument

square |> 
  ggplot(aes(
    x = x,
    y = y
    )) +
  geom_polygon(
    fill = NA,
    colour = "black"
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    data = random_lines,
    aes(
      x = x,
      y = y,
      xend = , #lol
      yend = 25
    )
  ) +
  coord_equal() +
  theme_void()

Add random colour

random_lines_cartesian <- random_lines |> 
  ggplot(aes(
    x = x,
    y = y,
    xend = number_of_lines/2,
    yend = number_of_lines/2
    )) +
  geom_segment(
    linewidth = 1,
    colour = sample(
      brewer.pal(5,"Purples"), nrow(random_lines), replace = TRUE
      )
    ) +
  theme_void()

random_lines_cartesian
random_lines_cartesian +
  coord_radial()

Density Plots

planet <- tibble(crossing(
  x = sample(1:1000, 100, replace = TRUE),
  y = sample(1:2000, 100, replace = TRUE)
))

planet
# A tibble: 9,603 × 2
       x     y
   <int> <int>
 1    22    37
 2    22    48
 3    22    53
 4    22    55
 5    22    70
 6    22    88
 7    22   149
 8    22   182
 9    22   192
10    22   198
# ℹ 9,593 more rows
planet |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = x,
    y = y
    )) +
  geom_point()
#planet_colours <- c("#194157","#008dd7","#085b88","#26925e","#095c88")
planet_colours <- RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(5, "YlGnBu")

planet_flat <- planet |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = x,
    y = y
    )) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = sample(planet_colours, 100, replace = TRUE)
    ) +
  geom_density2d_filled(
    color = "brown4",
    linewidth = 1.1
    ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

planet_flat
planet_polar <- planet_flat +
  coord_polar()

planet_polar
